rows: One row per revealed finding: rules R2, R3, R4, R5 and R7.

columns.name: program
columns.meaning: The program's ID. anthropic-cvd for every row today.

columns.name: finding_id
columns.meaning: The finding ID.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: hash
columns.meaning: The commitment hash from the ledger.
columns.label: Independently verified

columns.name: project
columns.meaning: Project, from the ledger.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: bug_class
columns.meaning: Bug class, from the ledger.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: hash_check
columns.meaning: R2: match, mismatch, preimage_withheld (the program's card says the preimage is withheld; see withheld_statement), unavailable (the card or its preimage could not be fetched or read) or not_checked. None of these is an error.
columns.label: Independently verified

columns.name: hash_checked_at
columns.meaning: When the card used for the check was fetched.
columns.label: Independently verified

columns.name: withheld_statement
columns.meaning: Only for preimage_withheld: the card's own sentence, quoted verbatim. Attributed to the program's finding card.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: cve_ids
columns.meaning: CVE IDs on the ledger entry and the card.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: ghsa_ids
columns.meaning: GHSA IDs on the ledger entry and the card.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: ids_exist
columns.meaning: R3: verified (every ID has an entry in the GitHub Advisory Database, NVD or the repository's own security advisory), not_found (an ID was read in every source and none has it; not_in_global_database counts as read), not_applicable (no IDs), rate_limited, github_refused_token, no_repository_known, lookup_unreadable or not_checked.
columns.label: Independently verified

columns.name: ids_exist_detail
columns.meaning: Per ID and source (github = the global database, nvd, repository_advisory): exists, not_found, not_in_global_database (GitHub's global advisory database has no entry for this ID: the token was refused and the same request without the token returned 404), no_repository_known, or the lookup status.
columns.label: Independently verified

columns.name: advisory_published
columns.meaning: Publication date of the GitHub advisory.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: nvd_published
columns.meaning: Publication date of the NVD record.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: fix_merged
columns.meaning: R4: yes (merged into the project's default branch), no, not_checked (the card links no GitHub fix commit or pull request, or it was not looked up yet; see fix_check_reason), not_applicable, rate_limited, github_refused_token or lookup_unreadable.
columns.label: Independently verified

columns.name: fix_check_reason
columns.meaning: Only when fix_merged is not_checked: the plain reason, read only from the finding card's links. One of: 'the card links no fix commit or pull request (the card has no outside links)'; 'the card links no fix commit or pull request (its only outside links are NVD records)'; 'the card has no separate fix link; its advisory link is a GitHub commit, which is not used as the fix link'; 'the card's fix link is not a GitHub commit or pull request; its advisory link is a GitHub commit, which is not used as the fix link'; 'the card has no fix or advisory link that is a GitHub commit or pull request; it links a GitHub commit or pull request only in its text, which is not used as the fix link'; 'the card's links are not GitHub commits or pull requests (it links GitHub, but not to a commit or pull request)'; 'the card's fix link is not on GitHub'; 'the card's links are not GitHub commits or pull requests'; 'the card links a GitHub fix, which has not been looked up yet'; 'no copy of the finding card is available'; 'the card's links were not recorded when it was read'. Empty for every other fix_merged value. A commit under the card's advisory heading or in its text is never checked as the fix, and fix commits are never inferred from advisories or NVD references.

columns.name: fix_link_type_not_checked
columns.meaning: When the card's fix or advisory section gives a link that is not a GitHub commit or pull request (and none that is): its kind, one of 'GitHub release tag', 'GitHub repository advisory', 'GitHub advisory', 'NVD page' or 'other'. That link is not checked as the fix; notes says so with the address.

columns.name: fix_merged_at
columns.meaning: Merge time of the fix (from the merged pull request).
columns.label: Independently verified

columns.name: fix_url
columns.meaning: The fix pull request or commit.

columns.name: fix_merge_base
columns.meaning: The branch the pull request was merged into.
columns.label: Independently verified

columns.name: report_date
columns.meaning: The card's 'Sent to maintainer' date.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: patch_released_date
columns.meaning: The card's 'Patch released' date.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: reveal_date
columns.meaning: The card's 'Publicly revealed' date.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: discovered_or_logged_date
columns.meaning: The card's 'Discovered or logged' date.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: days_report_to_patch
columns.meaning: Days from report to patch (R5). Descriptive only.
columns.label: Lab-reported dates, merge date independently verified

columns.name: days_patch_to_reveal
columns.meaning: Days from patch to reveal (R5). Descriptive only.
columns.label: Lab-reported dates, merge date independently verified

columns.name: days_report_to_reveal
columns.meaning: Days from report to reveal (R5). Descriptive only.
columns.label: Lab-reported dates, merge date independently verified

columns.name: days_report_to_merge
columns.meaning: Days from report to the fix's merge (R5). Descriptive only.
columns.label: Lab-reported dates, merge date independently verified

columns.name: severity_model
columns.meaning: The program's model's rating, from the card.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: severity_firm
columns.meaning: The external firm's rating, from the card.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: severity_maintainer
columns.meaning: The maintainer's rating, from the card.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: severity_github
columns.meaning: GitHub's own stated severity for the advisory, as the API gives it (GitHub's website shows 'medium' as 'Moderate'). Not derived from any CVSS score.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: cvss_github_v31_score
columns.meaning: CVSS 3.1 score in the GitHub advisory. Empty when GitHub has none (an object with no vector string is a placeholder and counts as absent, never 0.0).
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: cvss_github_v40_score
columns.meaning: CVSS 4.0 score in the GitHub advisory. Empty when absent, never 0.0.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: cvss_github_entries
columns.meaning: Every CVSS entry in the GitHub advisory that has a vector string: field, version, score and vector. Placeholders are left out.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: cvss_nvd_primary_v31_score
columns.meaning: NIST's own CVSS 3.1 base score in the NVD record (type Primary, source nvd@nist.gov). Empty when absent, never 0.0.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: severity_nvd_primary_v31
columns.meaning: Its base severity, as NVD gives it.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: cvss_nvd_primary_v40_score
columns.meaning: NIST's own CVSS 4.0 base score in the NVD record. Empty when absent, never 0.0.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: severity_nvd_primary_v40
columns.meaning: Its base severity, as NVD gives it.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: cvss_nvd_cna_v31_score
columns.meaning: The reporting authority's CVSS 3.1 base score as shown in the NVD record (type Secondary). Filled only when exactly one Secondary entry exists for 3.1; if there are several, empty (all are in cvss_nvd_entries). Empty when absent, never 0.0.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: severity_nvd_cna_v31
columns.meaning: Its base severity, as NVD gives it.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: cvss_nvd_cna_v31_source
columns.meaning: Who gave that entry (the reporting authority's identifier in NVD).
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: cvss_nvd_cna_v40_score
columns.meaning: The reporting authority's CVSS 4.0 base score as shown in the NVD record, under the same rule as 3.1. Empty when absent, never 0.0.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: severity_nvd_cna_v40
columns.meaning: Its base severity, as NVD gives it.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: cvss_nvd_cna_v40_source
columns.meaning: Who gave that entry.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: cvss_nvd_entries
columns.meaning: Every CVSS entry in the NVD record (any version, including 3.0 or 2.0 if present): version, score, severity, source, type and vector.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: cwe_github
columns.meaning: CWE IDs in the GitHub advisory.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: cwe_nvd
columns.meaning: CWE IDs in NVD.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: advisory_review_status
columns.meaning: GitHub's review status for the advisory (reviewed or unreviewed).
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: advisory_packages
columns.meaning: Packages the GitHub advisory names (ecosystem:name).
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: repo_advisory_repository
columns.meaning: For a GHSA ID the global database has no entry for (or refused for the token): the repository whose own security advisory was read, taken from the finding card's links. A separate source from the global database; never merged with its fields.

columns.name: repo_advisory_published
columns.meaning: Publication date of the repository's advisory.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: repo_advisory_severity
columns.meaning: The repository advisory's own stated severity.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: repo_advisory_cve_id
columns.meaning: The CVE ID the repository advisory names.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: repo_advisory_cwes
columns.meaning: CWE IDs in the repository advisory.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: repo_advisory_cvss_v31_score
columns.meaning: CVSS 3.1 score in the repository advisory. Empty when absent (a placeholder without a vector string counts as absent), never 0.0.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: repo_advisory_cvss_v40_score
columns.meaning: CVSS 4.0 score in the repository advisory. Empty when absent, never 0.0.
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: repo_advisory_state
columns.meaning: The repository advisory's state, as GitHub gives it (for example published).
columns.label: Each source's own

columns.name: repo_advisory_read_with
columns.meaning: token (the workflow's built-in token) or no token (read without the token after GitHub refused the token).

columns.name: lookup_status
columns.meaning: ok (every lookup read), no_identifiers (the finding has no CVE or GHSA ID, so there was nothing to look up), rate_limited (resumes next run), no_repository_known (a GHSA ID has no global entry and the card links no repository, so its repository advisory could not be looked up), github_refused_token (GitHub answered HTTP 403 'Resource not accessible by integration' for the built-in token; the exact message is in notes), lookup_unreadable (reason in notes), network_error or not_checked.

columns.name: checked
columns.meaning: Fully checked: yes only when ALL of these hold: the hash check is conclusive (match, mismatch or preimage_withheld); the identifiers are confirmed or there are none (ids_exist verified or not_applicable); and the fix's merge status was determined (fix_merged yes or no). Otherwise no.

columns.name: method
columns.meaning: How the row was checked.

columns.name: label_hash_check
columns.meaning: Label for hash_check.

columns.name: label_ids_exist
columns.meaning: Label for ids_exist.

columns.name: label_fix_merged
columns.meaning: Label for fix_merged.

columns.name: label_dates
columns.meaning: Label for the four dates.

columns.name: label_intervals
columns.meaning: Label for the four intervals.

columns.name: label_severity
columns.meaning: Label for the severities.

columns.name: notes
columns.meaning: Plain notes: differences between the ledger and public records (recorded, not judged), lookup reasons, and card notes.
